description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

uses.name: Necrogen Communion
uses.cardState: attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos
